caption: The drawing depicts a horse-drawn carriage on a plain, light-colored background. The carriage is mainly yellow with green vertical window slats and a red rectangular door. There is a decorative pattern resembling leopard spots and red panels along the lower half of the carriage. The carriage stands on two large green-rimmed wheels in the back and two smaller green wheels in the front. A person in blue clothing and a black cap is sitting on the driver's seat at the front of the carriage, holding two reins attached to the harness of a gray horse. The horse is shown in motion with a red strap around its body and metal horseshoes on its feet. The artist's signature, "Page Coffman," is visible near the front left wheel of the carriage.
title: Toy - Two Horse Hack
